patthana13.16:1.1: maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na maggārammaṇo ca na maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na maggahetuko ca na maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na maggārammaṇo ca na maggahetuko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na maggārammaṇo ca na maggahetuko ca na maggādhipati ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: satta.
patthana13.16:2.1: hetuyā pañcattiṃsa avigate pañcattiṃsa sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ. uppannattike nauppannattikaṃ
